config.funding_reference_price: perpetual open at the settlement hour

deflated_sharpe_detail.scope: every strategy and parameter set of this V11 run

notes: V11 run on BTC, ETH, SOL, BTC.SPOT, ETH.SPOT, SOL.SPOT; data snapshot d4beec019a0aec14 (manifest 2026-11-15-v11.json)

maximum leverage and maintenance fraction of an instrument on another venue are taken from the same underlying on Hyperliquid (a simplification: edgeX allows more leverage and a lower maintenance margin)
equity_curve is the test split, valued at the close of each bar (timestamps are bar-open times, UTC)
cross-margin account in USDC; weights are signed fractions of account equity (negative = short)

funding: every hourly settlement is charged at the open of the bar that starts at its hour, on the position held coming into that bar: amount = -signed size x perpetual open x rate (Hyperliquid pays on the ORACLE price; historical oracle prices are not served, the perpetual's own price is used instead)
initial margin = notional / leverage, checked at order time: reducing orders always execute, orders adding exposure are cut pro rata to the free collateral or refused below the minimum order
maintenance margin = notional x flat fraction (Hyperliquid: half of the initial margin at maximum leverage); NO margin tiers by size

liquidation is intrabar: with every long at the bar's low and every short at its high together, the account is liquidated where margin equity = maintenance margin, at that price, plus taker fee and a penalty; the WHOLE account is closed (no partial liquidation, no backstop, no auto-deleveraging)
highs and lows are trade prices of the perpetual, not the venue's mark price (which is smoother): wicks liquidate here that might not on the venue
equity <= 0 marks the run wiped out: equity stays at 0, the unpaid loss is reported as bad debt
ledger in exact decimals; average entry price rounded half-even at 18 decimals, sizes truncated to the lot
max_drawdown and worst_intrabar_drawdown are positive fractions; sharpe/sortino/volatility are annualised with 8760 bars per year (24/7 market), risk-free rate 0
parameters on the test split are META['params']; the sensitivity grid never selects them
look-ahead check: truncation test on 864 bars, cuts at [0.5, 0.8], 864 decisions compared
v11 execution model: see execution_model (latency bound, size-dependent slippage, fees per venue, one account per venue); engine rules: see engine_parity

latency.statement: decision on the bar's close; a buy fills at open + f x (high - open), a sell at open - f x (open - low) of the NEXT bar, f = min(1, sqrt(delay / bar length)); the k-th exposure-adding order of a decision is delayed by k x order_spacing_s more. A bound, always against the order; booked as the cost line `latency`

slippage.calibration: research/src/spq/params/book_calibration.json: order books recorded 2026-11-16T00:32:07.790000+00:00 to 2026-11-16T01:39:44.180000+00:00, 3 of 6 symbols
slippage.statement: cost_bps = half spread + Y x sigma_bar x sqrt(order notional / mean USD volume per bar), sigma and volume on the bars before the fill; where a recorded depth profile is supplied the cost is read on it instead (never below the half spread)

hyperliquid.name: hyperliquid
hyperliquid.notes: minimum order 10 USD notional; funding paid every hour on the oracle price

spot.name: spot
spot.source: lab assumption for an on-chain swap (router fee + pool fee + price impact), research/README.md 'Known limits'; the engine's own floor is MIN_TRADE_USD = 2 (services/api/src/agents/engine.ts:31)
spot.notes: spot legs are Coinbase candles; execution in the wallet is an on-chain swap. Gas is not modelled

accounts.statement: one cross-margin account per venue with its own collateral, margin check and liquidation; no transfer between venues; a liquidated account's loss beyond its collateral is written off (it cannot reach another venue)

execution_model.liquidation: perpetuals: exact intrabar model of version 2, per account; spot legs: not applicable (unlevered, never liquidated)

max_leverage.rule: account leverage and leverage setting of every order: min(this, venue maximum)

max_gross_exposure_x.rule: sum of |notional| <= this x capital x (1 - cap_headroom - slippage bound)

max_position_x.rule: largest |notional| <= this x capital x (1 - cap_headroom - slippage bound)

max_daily_loss_pct.rule: equity at the start of the UTC day - equity >= this % of the capital: flatten, then stop

max_total_loss_pct.rule: capital - equity >= this % of the capital: flatten, then stop

slippage_bps.rule: worst price of an IOC order beyond the best opposite price; also enters the cap headroom

min_trade_pct.rule: a rebalance smaller than this % of equity is not traded (a full exit always is)

leverage_headroom.rule: gross <= max_leverage x equity x this

cap_headroom.rule: the absolute caps are approached to within this share plus the slippage bound

min_notional_factor.rule: an order must clear the venue minimum notional by this factor

loop_period_s.rule: one engine pass per minute: a decision taken on a closed bar reaches the venue up to this long after the close

live_cooldown_s.rule: LIVE: an exposure-adding order waits until the previous one is this old, i.e. ONE exposure-adding order per pass (per minute); reduce-only orders are not delayed

max_orders_per_minute.rule: risk-engine policy of the agent account

max_orders_per_day.rule: risk-engine policy of the agent account

engine_parity.statement: the owner's DEFAULT limits: weights scaled by one factor to the leverage, gross and position caps; minimum trade; venue minimum x factor; one exposure-adding order per engine pass; loss limits and liquidation stop the agent (flatten at the next open, no further decision). config.rebalance_threshold is replaced by min_trade_pct

survivorship.statement: the universe was chosen on the run date among instruments that are listed and liquid today; an instrument that was delisted or lost its liquidity during the window cannot be in it. Results are conditional on having picked survivors.

listing_date_truncation.statement: the common window starts at the latest first bar among the symbols (a venue's history depth or a listing date); earlier bars of the other symbols are not used

common_clock.statement: bars missing on any symbol are dropped for all (no filling); the mask of each symbol on the union grid is summarised in per_symbol

journal.reproducibility: no wall-clock value is in this report: generated_at is the capture time of the data snapshot. Same strategy file, lab source, data snapshot, seed and starting ledger reproduce it byte for byte
